description: 《小先生 Little ShiFu》是一款以中式民俗恐怖为核心的悬疑解谜游戏。玩家将扮演十八岁的道士张清一，中元将至在终南长鸣的夜里，在阴雾笼罩的长鸣古镇，调查接连发生的五桩索命怪事。游戏剧情故事发生在一座被阴雾笼罩的古镇——长鸣镇。镇中城隍庙香火未断，却流传着“中元夜，生死乱”的禁忌。多年前，道士张启山以命镇煞，为儿子留下了一场生死棋局。 2005年中元前夜，五鬼索命，棋局现世，十八岁的张清一被卷入阴阳死局。自由探索长鸣镇阴雾笼罩，老街、废宅、祠堂、庙宇皆藏旧事。玩家将化身张清一，自由探索小镇，搜集线索，破解机关，追查真相。一张旧照、一封书信、一尊残像，都可能牵出新的因果。探索顺序与所得法器，将影响后续遭遇与剧情走向。中元将至，鬼门渐开，破局之路由你选择。

title: Katana Killer Demo
description: In your hands is the ultimate weapon: a cyber katana. You are the world’s deadliest assassin. Your target is hiding inside a skyscraper crawling with enemies. Cut down everything in your path and reach your target.

title: Wildegrove Demo
description: Wildegrove is a fast-paced magical roguelike isometric bullet hell where you wield powerful spells as a gnome chosen by the gods. Battle the relentless waves of enemies, collect runes that compliment your playstyle, and upgrade your favorite spells to unleash devastating blows to save Wildegrove!

title: 我们纯真的青春 Demo
description: 《我们纯真的青春》是根据黑岩阅读网、磨铁中文网签约作者“一织”的同名小说改编成的视觉小说游戏。 原著以独具特点的幽默文风、出其不意的机灵语言备受网友追捧，更引发了读者对青春记忆与情感的共鸣和探讨。

title: Aetherantis Realm of Fates Demo
description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. Explore the floating continent via dice rolls, construct settlements and cities, and turn matches around with fate cards. Enjoy couch tabletop gameplay with up to four local players.

title: Pizza Boy Demo
description: Pizza Boy is a first-person pizzeria simulator where you become the cashier, chef, and server all at once. Your job is to take orders, build pizzas, and deliver them before they leave.

title: Ocean Homeward:Soul Summoner Survivors Demo
description: Play as a Soul Summoner, sail the nether Ocean, survive monster hordes. Awaken spirits, collect soul fragments, craft gear sets and build unique combat styles.

title: ConfigNexus Demo
description: 这是一个面向游戏开发者的数据配置工作流平台，支持字段类型、数据校验、Excel 导入与多格式导出，拥有富文本编辑，多数据编辑，json编辑，文件浏览器等诸多特性，可以让游戏开发者提升效率，事半功倍！

title: Xeno Clip Demo
description: A top-down shooter Roguelike. You are a prospector, venturing deep into an alien planet to complete "planetary exploration": clearing , choosing , collecting , and experiencing the exhilarating feeling . It's a game in aiming, movement, and deck building.

title: Icon: Voidfall Demo
description: Command Arafel or the Arx Imperium in this Early Alpha RTS demo. Experience asymmetric warfare, online 1v1 multiplayer, and single-player battles as the Voidfall begins.

title: Mine the Deep Demo
description: Battle relentless drone swarms, mine valuable resources, and upgrade your ship into a devastating weapon platform.

title: Nin Ninja RESCUE MISSION Demo
description: Nin Ninja Rescue Mission is an action, adventure, platform, and endless runner game. Run, face dangerous enemies, dodge traps, defeat enemies, and use your skills to complete a rescue mission.

title: Todd The Tubby Toad Demo
developer: Eduardo Cavalcante, Kyla Reine, André Borja, Sebastian Beltran

title: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator Demo
description: Arcade train driving game about collecting, managing, and delivering resources with incremental and strategic elements. Manage, upgrade, and defend Mining Stations, drive your Train through the network of underground caves, grow numbers and multiply Profits in a dark neocapitalistic future

title: Don't Make a Sound Demo
description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake in a morgue as intern Shen Ting. 4 rules. Remember one: speak and you die. Your mic monitors volume—any sound above the threshold ends your game. Mic required.

title: Retromine Demo
description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

title: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator Demo
Rank & Ruin Demo
description: Real-time squad combat meets roguelite progression. Pick your faction, earn legendary heroes on the battlefield, and grow stronger with every run in Rank & Ruin

title: Seaward Demo
description: In this flooded world you become a courier, connecting people with your ship. Scattered across islands you'll find resources to improve your ship and make it your home. Help out cute characters and build a community. And don't forget to take photos along the way.

title: Forgotten Station Demo
description: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

title: A Moon Full of Money Demo
description: Blast rocks, upgrade your base, and earn lots of money in this compact incremental game. Expand and automate your operation with powerful abilities like mining robots, drones, mines, supply drops, an orbital laser, and more.

title: Single Note Alpha
description: Single Note Alpha is a free standalone alpha build created to introduce players to the world, atmosphere, and core mechanics of the full game.This Alpha tells a separate short story and does not spoil the main story of the final release.

title: Prove it Blob! Demo
description: Prove It Blob is a relaxing puzzle game where you solve riddles and use the power of telekinesis to rearrange the appearance of the world.

title: The Underground Press Demo
description: An atmospheric first-person psychological horror. You are a journalist who descended into an abandoned metro for the sake of a sensation. In the demo version, exploration of the first closed station, interactive puzzles, and an encounter with the unknown await you.

title: All Time High Demo
description: The free Act I of a moral-descent thriller told through your phone, your feeds, and a trading terminal. Chase a California fortune one "just one more trade" at a time — until a private door opens. ~40 minutes to the edge of the fall. Wishlist for the full descent.

title: Dacan Express: Logistic manager Demo
description: Welcome to Dacan Express! Build, manage, and expand your own logistics empire in this solo-developed management game. Hire staff, negotiate contracts, and keep your couriers on the move. 👉 Please Wishlist the game on Steam!

title: A Game About Shooting Ducks Demo
description: In this incremental game, you shoot ducks and earn money. Use your earnings to buy dogs and traps and hire hunters to help you hunt even more ducks. Progress through levels, battle powerful bosses, and work toward making the entire duck population extinct!

title: Times of Progress Demo
description: Times of Progress is a City Builder set during the Industrial Revolution. Build industries to extract natural resources. Produce goods to satisfy the population. Manage transportation routes by train and ship. Expand on procedurally generated maps.

title: Police Chief Simulator Demo
description: Free demo of the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

title: VECTORHYTHM Demo
description: Master the beat. Chain perfectly timed shots. Build insane weapon synergies. Survive endless waves in this fast-paced rhythm survivor inspired by classic arcade shooters. Demo version includes a small taste of the game. This demo contains a small sample of the full forthcoming game.

title: Eyes Wide Open Demo
description: For a single day, Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

title: Spooky Bodies Demo
description: Spooky Bodies is a cozy puzzle game with a ghostly twist. Switch between ghost and human by using traps or possessing bodies. Each form offers unique abilities. Combine them cleverly and interact with the world to solve creative, brain-teasing puzzles.

title: Traveloot Demo
description: Traveloot is a solo or couch co-op run-based incremental adventure where you explore islands, gather resources, recruit adventurers, and grow stronger through an upgrade tree.

title: OMEA Demo
description: OMEA is an AI-powered narrative RPG where you say what you would actually do, and the story responds. The demo is one full adventure called Odin's Trial.You are a Viking, washed up alone on a frozen island. Odin has given you one job: find the beast, the great wolf, and put it down.

title: TV Network Simulator Demo
description: Build and manage your own TV network. Schedule shows, hire staff, attract sponsors, create original productions and compete for ratings in this management simulation.

title: Block Machine Demo
description: * In the Demo version, you can experience the early part of the game. There will be certain limitations on scoring and obtaining items. The complete content will be presented in the official version. Thank you for your experience!

title: Paradox Tower Demo
description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

title: FEED ME MORE BRAINS Demo
description: The demo of FEED ME MORE BRAINS, a silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

title: Memory Palace Demo
description: Rescue the princess by defeating your foes at memory card games in this retro styled pixel art adventure. Think quick for the hugely satisfying Perfect Match. Memory Palace is a great way to relax while exercising your brain.

title: Train Goes Choo Choo Demo
description: A nostalgic window into Japanese slice-of-life, perfect for those who find peace in the quiet beauty of rural landscapes and the rhythmic flow of a journey..

title: Factory on a Train Demo
description: Mine, craft and extend your Factory on a Train! As you find more resources and unlock increasingly complex recipes, your train grows and your production increases. Choose the right cars to face the challenges of the post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: Diary: White
description: Diary: White is a 2D psychological horror adventure game. Explore from a collapsing school to a gloomy house, and collect clues to solve mysteries. Hide from dark entities, survive terrifying hallucinations, and make a final life-or-death choice to determine your own fate.

title: Yokai Idle Demo
description: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, train skills, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎

title: Solitaire - Complete Collection Demo
description: Build sequences, clear foundations, and master each game's unique rules.

title: Trenchcoat Adventurer Vol 1 : Gone Rogue Demo
description: THE DEMO is the 1st 5 LEVELS to let you explore our unforgiving roguelike permadeath turn-based dungeon crawler that sees Topp, Meedul, and Bawtom fresh out of retirement and back on the hunt for loot and shinies.  Stronger enemies. New dangers. Can you survive?

title: Severwood Demo
description: Forge runes into your beast, chain glyph combos into screen-clearing chaos, and evolve through a cursed dark-fantasy forest. A roguelite deckbuilder where every socket is a choice and every run rewrites your power. Hunt down the Soul Lord. Descend deeper. Die hungrier.

title: Shift Chess Demo
description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

title: FLATLINE Demo
description: FLATLINE is a dark kinetic novel about bureaucracy on the edge of the abyss. Follow the routine of a rank-and-file engineer in a brutalist, dystopian London where the state-run BHS replaces dead biology with paid digital impulses. Pay to feel.

title: Logistik Demo
description: Build, schedule, and optimize your rail network, with every track reshaping the world. Balance fuel costs, adapt to the terrain, and fulfill demands. Elevate Trains to the ultimate means of transport!

title: Mafia Hero: Streets of Survival Demo
description: Survivors-like game with ONLINE CO-OP (1–4 PLAYERS). The man who had always played by the rules was dead.! Mafia Hero: Streets of Survival is an online co-op auto-shooter roguelite for up to 4 players. Build your criminal empire, craft powerful builds, and battle massive bosses.

title: My Cozy Cube Demo
description: My Cozy Cube is a cozy game about stickers. Collage stickers according to the reference, or combine them freely for your own cube. Have fun with the cozy collaging journey with your red panda guide, Chessie!

title: Cards of the Abyss Demo
description: Cards of the Abyss is a roguelike deckbuilder where movement is your only defense. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, trigger countless chain-reactions and unleash overpowered card combos as you dive deeper into the Abyss.

title: 最强仙门 Demo
description: This is a sect management simulation game. It features over 200 manuals for learning skills, more than 600 NPCs to interact with and explore, and 1,200+ divine artifacts for combat—not to mention an endless supply of procedurally generated gear.

title: Bravest! Side Story: KURIMOTO QUEST Demo
Dark Bone Prison Demo
description: This is a dungeon-based game full of oppressive atmosphere. You will delve into the maze filled with monsters, collect, combine and upgrade weapons, and fight for a glimmer of hope in the successive waves of attacks.

title: Rail Guard Demo
description: Expand your railway, automate production, build powerful defenses, and protect your tracks from relentless enemies in this incremental idle tower defense game.

title: Nicotine Merchant Simulator Demo
description: You're a Nicotine Merchant. Start your production using improvised materials and grow it into a large enterprise. But be careful, just a few wrong moves and everything could fall apart!

title: DIBARO Demo
description: Roll dice, command mana, fight on a hex board with up to 6 factions. Five elements — Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Void — carry unique effects and counters. Read rivals through mana layout, resources, and positioning. Build your Hunter, conquer Challenges, Survival, or Demon & Hero. Tactics and luck.

title: slice Demo
description: A look at the upcoming life sim, slice. Play life on your terms.

title: Mind Mirror Demo
description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

title: Overbooked Demo
description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

title: The Phone Game Demo
description: The Phone Game is a chaotic physics game where you play an old phone, smash through playful levels, trigger chain reactions, use wild powerups, and launch revenge at Bobby who threw you away. Crazy combos, unlock APPs, collect cosmetics, and turn every world into a playground of chaotic destruction.

title: Protocol 73: The Zenith Demo
description: Master precision combat, command a shapeshifting companion, and fall deeper into Corruption. A narrative-driven soulslike where every choice defines who you become.

title: Astral Planes Demo
description: You're an astral miner, drifting through the stars. Collect fragments to shape the music through motion. Just another day restoring harmony to the cosmos.

title: LUMEN BLACK Demo
description: Light is your only weapon. Reveal the path, survive the dark.

title: Melody Explorer Demo
description: Set the Scale. Follow your dopamine. Melody Explorer turns your QWERTY keyboard into an intuitive, harmoniously safe music production tool. Explore beautiful scales and chords instantly without formal training—zero wrong notes, endless creative inspiration.

title: 海潮之汐：引路人 Demo
description: A complete plot story of over 200,000 words, where you listen to prayers, discover and resolve the other party's emotional entanglements, develop the protagonist, plant and harvest exotic underwater plants, decorate each character's room, and collect tarot cards and various collectibles ..

title: Silly Soccer Mini-Game: Dribble Master Demo
description: This is a funny little soccer game with super simple controls. Enemies on the field will rush straight for your ball—don’t let them touch it. The longer you survive, the higher your score.

title: Dakota Keys and the Secret of the Ancients Demo
Eshlords Demo
description: Run, slide and jump your way through procedural mazes set in a surreal fever-dream metropolis and attempt to escape before it's too late. Escape quick enough and challenge others to beat it faster or go for that top spot.

title: Jeremy is Broke Demo
description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

title: Moonlit Journey:  Homestead Demo
description: Purchase your homestead, master unique skills, and uncover hidden secrets in a cozy top-down farming RPG where the world transforms through all four seasons.

title: Lethal Signal Demo
description: Lethal Signal is a fast paced dystopian FPS where the system built to repopulate the world finds the truth buried in the collapse. What remains of life runs through your blood, yet the system has marked it as a threat.

title: Hustle Together Demo
description: Hustle together is a top down space action-RPG for 1-4 players.  Hustle for bling by scavenging, salvaging, hunting and trading.  Spend bling on upgrades for your ship, or over 100 upgradeable weapons.

title: FlipPanic Demo
description: Flip the panels to launch enemies — and your friends — off the stage! A top-down arcade party game inspired by 8-bit classics. Clear 8 stages and beat the boss solo, survive waves in online co-op, or knock each other off in PvP. Simple rules, endless mind games. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

title: Table Of Truth Demo
description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

title: Magic Shop Simulator Demo
description: Run a magic shop in an open voxel world. Forage rare ingredients, brew potions at your cauldron, and sell them to a village of fantastical customers, then defend your shelves when the wilds come knocking. Cozy where you want it, dangerous the moment you push your luck.

title: Wizard Tournament Demo
description: Wizard Tournament is a tower-building autobattler where every run is a puzzle of placement, economy, and magical item synergies.Dive into the free demo,  giving you the chance experience every element of the game with only ranked and co-op mode disabled.

title: Lilac Prose Demo
description: A raw, cruel story about addiction, abuse, and recovery. A young man, bound by a vial of morphine, and a world that gives him just that, so long as there's a drop of him worth taking. It has to get worse before it gets better.

title: Disaster Scenario Demo
description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

description: Bore Bore DEMO

description: Scarlet's Last Call is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat 'em up. By night she runs a neon bar; by dawn she hunts bounties. Play as deadly femme fatale Scarlet in her sexy outfits and tear through cyber-gangs, hounds, and bosses with brutal combos and cinematic finishers. Every contract could be her last call.

title: Circuit Keep Demo
description: Your towers don't stop anything. Enemies walk straight over them. The only thing that turns them aside is a wall, so you build the maze yourself. Then the intrusions start fighting back. PHASE slides through your walls. HOPPER vaults over them. BREAKER eats them. You built the maze. Now defend it.

title: Exiled Ark Demo
description: You play as a survivor to build strongholds, scavenge resources, forge weapons, and battle inside and outside the vessel, while gradually repairing its damaged cabins. Space survival exploration, roguelike combat, six attribute cultivation systems and four tech trees with multiple endings to unlock.

title: Transit Demo
description: Transit is a dark narrative adventure starring a sarcastic sock puppet in a world looping itself to death. Ride midnight trains through collapsing timelines, free traumatised souls, and search for your sister lost inside the loop.

title: 价值投资者：50年生涯 Demo
Onward! Autobattles Demo
description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

title: Scenic Demo
description: A relaxing pixel-art escape room game where you uncover hidden secrets and solve reality-bending puzzles. Interact with the environment and get lost in its liminal beauty.

title: ECHO Demo
description: A precision platformer built around one rule: you leave echoes of yourself behind.Place an echo mid-jump — it becomes solid. A platform. A shield. A bridge. You carry three at a time. Every placement is a decision; every deletion, a second chance.One mechanic. Infinite depth. How it worksYour echoes aren't decorations — they're tools.

title: Moonset Proyect Demo
description: An action shooter against hordes of zombies where you must survive and resist increasingly dangerous waves in emblematic locations on the Costa del Sol.

title: The Bestest Knight Demo
description: Travel to the end of the world in this auto scroller RPG. Craft unique builds, discover powerful item combos, and transform your fragile stable boy into the Bestest Knight. In this DEMO version you can explore the first region and play until the rank of Elite Knight.

title: Magine: War of Restoration Demo
description: A real-time strategy game anyone can pick up, featuring “click-to-deploy” and “zero micromanagement”. On a continent of magic and engine, gather your remnants, rebuild under siege and restore a shattered empire. Say goodbye to complex RTS controls and enjoy the pure joy of strategy and epic battles!

title: Dark Rail Demo
description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

title: Columbine Demo
description: "One ending gives rise to the next wish." A dark story-driven 2D shooter with multiple endings.

title: Grease Trap '99 Demo
description: Story-driven Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

title: Incremental Frog Demo
description: Incremental Frog is a game where you catch insects with your tongue. Catch flies, earn gold and upgrade your tech tree.

title: Guardian of Boss Neko - Demo
description: Guardian of Boss Neko is a 2D anime-style survivor-like game with integrated guardian mechanics. Players take on the role of a young female escort and protect Boss Neko the catgirl from waves of monster attacks.

title: LunaGenesis Demo
description: LunaGenesis is a single-player psychological horror adventure about Scary Moonchild, an avatar of Will who sneaks through the plague-ridden rat-folk town of Brume and explores surreal dreams to collect information and expose what the Collegium is hiding.

title: Solar Core Demo
description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

title: Ribbit Riot! Demo
description: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

title: Gniewomir Demo
description: Open-world RPG with deck-building elements allowing you to combat mad storks and probably a god or two when the game will be finished. So far there are only storks. But fear not, plenty of magical creatures are on their way.

title: Soup's Tail Demo
description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

title: Mr. "Bargain Expert" 捡漏王 Demo
description: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

title: Silent Protocol Demo
description: Silent Protocol is a top-down experimental action arcade game that focuses on precise movement with mouse control, featuring unique one of a kind experience.

title: Yokai Crossing Demo
description: A 7-year-old boy has vanished inside his own home. Find him and uncover what happened beneath its walls, while evading the Yōkai that have claimed this place as their own.

description: Being & Becoming is an atmospheric metroidvania, set in a dying kingdom held together only by the collective dream of thousands of would-be martyrs. Fate itself is against you as The Word’s prophecy unfolds. Rewrite your place within The Word or become a scripted part of this horrible revelation.

title: The Ice is Watching Demo
developer: Oguz Abdullah Celik, Seyit Alashan, Hasan Yuce

description: Command your legion in a dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. Raise free-producing barracks, summon 10 unique heroes, gear them up, and smash the enemy base across two lanes. Pure strategy — no unit micro. Outwit the AI. Free to play.

title: Imprinted Demo
description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

title: Glintseeker Island Demo
description: Descend into mysterious caves with countless treasures to excavate in a mining exploration adventure. Upgrade your gear, fight bosses, uncover secrets and save the island from an ancient threat below!

title: Dead End: Escape Your Fears Abducted Demo
description: Trapped in a small room with dead animals sounds like anyone's worst fear, but what awaits you on the other side of the door? Puzzles are hidden in the most unexpected places, and even if you're clever enough to solve them... What makes you think the Millers will let you escape?

title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator Demo
description: Hit the road with your merchant caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

title: Mayak Demo
description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi visual novel about first contact.

title: Balls Together Demo
description: It’s not just a ball anymore, it’s your power. Roll, bump, and compete! Balls Together is a chaotic multiplayer party game where you control a ball and challenge friends in racing, soccer, party modes and crazy modes. Climb the global leaderboards and compete worldwide.

title: Dark Roll 2 Demo
description: A Souls-like inspired 3D platformer built around physics-based rolling, where every mistake can send you tumbling into danger. You’ll take on a series of uniquely designed levels packed with unforgiving environmental hazards that test your agility, logic, perseverance, and sanity.

title: GLANCED Demo
description: Step inside. Infiltrate the manor of porcelain dolls, some are maybe your friends. Steal the key from her cold neck, find the door, and whatever you do, don’t meet her eyes. One glance is enough to lose your body. GLANCED: forget FPS shooters. Here, just a look...KILLS. Now, just survive.

title: Guildrun Demo
description: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike demo. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

title: Primal One Demo
description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

title: Tickets, Please! Demo
description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxed cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair defects, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on rails in a relaxed yet hectic single-player experience.

title: NOMAD-san Demo
description: This is a coffee-break roguelike. Can you claim the Crown of Victory on the 31st floor? In the demo, you can play as one of the playable characters from the full version.

title: Twisted Ball Pool Demo
description: Twisted Ball Pool is a roguelite billiards game with unique table layouts, trick shots, and cue abilities you unlock to master every run!

title: Bonehearts Demo
description: In Bonehearts you control two clashing skeletons, one meek - one mighty, who are forced to share a body. Rip off your arm to bonk enemies, throw your head and maneuver it around. Use your skeletal abilities to defeat evil and explore a Halloween-inspired world in this humorous 3D-platformer.

title: Floor Glitch Demo
description: Escape from the anomalous 8-storey apartment building, where each floor gives you new challenges. You won't be able to just go down or use the elevator, the house will keep bringing you back until you solve the main task on each floor... Demo version contains only 8th floor.

title: Doodle Ball Demo
description: A cozy physics puzzle game where you draw lines with different properties to gently guide a ball and pick up all collectibles. Solve each challenge at your own pace in a world of cute, hand-drawn art.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time Demo
description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this roguelike tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

title: Pinkybites Demo
description: A 400 year old vampire wakes up in a band's basement with a stake hole in her chest and nowhere to go. She strikes a deal, front the band, win the Battle of the Bands, figure out what a dollar is. A story driven visual novel about music, found family, and a heart that forgot it could feel.

title: 弈统三国：三国五子棋 Demo
description: Three Kingdoms Gomoku combines classic Gomoku with Three Kingdoms themes and general skills. You can freely build decks from various factions, utilize generals' abilities to create brilliant tactical combos, and enjoy the unique fun of skill-based Gomoku.

title: Happy Little Farm Demo
description: Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days. However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

title: Colorful Craftworks Demo
description: Colorful Craftworks is a 2D puzzle game where you paint objects to change their properties and create new paths. Use colors to extinguish flames, transform obstacles, and solve carefully designed stages filled with creative, trial-and-error based challenges.

title: WARPED Demo
description: WARPED is a fast, retro-inspired twin-stick space shooter where you blast UFOs, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship, and fight across the solar system with your robot companion Zippy to uncover the source of a mysterious signal.

title: Fire Bug Demo
description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

title: Market at Moonfall Demo
description: Build a thriving fantasy marketplace by day, then defend it from monsters by night in this cozy management game with action, strategy, and endless customization.

title: Mourning House Demo
description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, a man awakens inside a mysterious house where his wife has vanished. Solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and find a way to escape before it's too late.

title: Juice Stand Tycoon Demo
description: Juice Stand Tycoon is a casual business simulation game about growing a small neighborhood juice stand into a busy local favorite.Each day starts with planning. Buy ingredients, adjust your recipes, set prices, and decide whether to spend money on upgrades or advertising.

title: Flipping Out Demo
description: Flipping Out is a pinball rage game. Think: "Getting Over It" meets pinball. Control the flippers on a giant pinball machine, flinging the ball higher and higher. Be careful though - one wrong flip can send you cascading to the ground.

title: Her Remember You Demo
description: An AI desktop Live-Action companion who truly remembers you. Featuring real conversation memory, smart memo system, emotional, and support for both local offline models and cloud APIs. she learns you grows with you. Choose from multiple beautifully animated characters,each with a unique personality.

title: Run Chubby Run Demo
description: In this DEMO, you can enjoy 1 complete level of gameplay, in which you run while a Bear chases you, you can scare it away by waving a torch, while jumping over obstacles, consuming fruit to maintain your energy and discovering collectible medals for achievements, all while escaping.

title: Origins TCG Demo
description: The 1st free-2-compete TCG. Compete on skill alone (zero pay-to-win) for limited digital cards you can trade, grade, and sell!

title: My Racing Car Demo
description: Drag rusted wrecks from the scrapyard and rebuild them from scratch, one part at a time. A raw open-world driving life-sim — fix your car, fuel it, and hit the road. Race for cash, explore a living forest town, and survive the grind. Drive. Don't stop.

title: Mike the Hooper Demo
description: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

title: Untitled Ghost Game Demo
description: You are dead, now make it everyone else's problem.

title: Nui Goes to Town! Demo
description: Nui Goes to Town is a psychological horror game where you explore and interact with various animals - helping them with chores and discovering the dark secrets behind the world around you. You cut grass, dig holes, and stab....things.

title: Railpunk Mayhem Demo
description: All aboard! Enjoy a unique, fast-paced roguelike action experience. In Railpunk Mayhem, survive relentless waves of enemies at breakneck speeds, build a powerful train to manage your crew, and strategically plan your route to the source of chaos.

title: Grim Path Demo
description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

title: Architects of the Universe: The Orbital Wars Demo
Resort Architect Demo
description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

title: Crownrats Demo
description: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

title: Doom Reignite Demo
description: The apocalypse crisis erupts again, and mutated zombies threaten the only humans left. As a member of the Atlas Doomsday Squad, explore survival in a Roguelike world with a Lowpoly art style, gather resources, refine gear, and seek a path forward for humanity.
developer: Chengdu Shengming Leyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 8BIT HUNTER Demo
description: Protect villages as an 8-Bit Hunter in this nostalgic top-down retro game! Defeat monsters, robbers, and bandits. Earn money for weapons & upgrades by completing quests.

title: Wild East: The Straw Man Demo
description: A 1990s point-and-click mystery set in post-communist Slovakia. Play as journalist Marek Varga and follow the first trail through dead ends, missing papers, old apartments, and people with reasons to lie.

title: The Duke is Dead Demo
description: The official demo for the upcoming detective game The Duke is Dead! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and use deduction to find the killer. Put your skills to the test to unravel the trail of crimes and uncover the truth!

title: Citadels - Shadow City Demo
description: Welcome to the Citadels: Shadow City DemoStep into the world of Citadels: Shadow City, a strategic turn-based card game of hidden roles, bluffing, and city-building set in a dark fantasy medieval world.In this demo, you'll get your first taste of the game's core mechanics:Build your city by constructing powerful districts.

title: Bound By A Curse Demo
description: A two-player asymmetric horror game where one player explores a dangerous environment while the other guides them from a control room. A curse causes you to swap positions throughout the game at random times, letting you experience both roles and creating chaotic moments.

title: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator Demo
Green Inferno Demo
description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. In this demo, begin your investigation into a doomed expedition. Examine the first detailed scenes, collect clip-based evidence, and start connecting the clues to uncover a macabre, analog nightmare.

title: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades Demo
乌合之罪 Demo
description: 《乌合之罪》是一款校园霸凌复仇X悬疑惊悚恋爱的沉浸式AVG，你（玩家）所饰演的主人公将在与外界彻底断联的诡异孤岛上历经一场极端恶意的厮杀，请找回记忆，推进剧情，抵达十四年前遗落的真相……

title: Wall Street Tycoon Demo
description: Try the free demo of Wall Street Tycoon: click your way from broke intern to your first fortune. Play the full early game up to your first prestige, hit the casino, and ride the markets. Love it? Wishlist the full game!

title: Money Under The Bed Demo
description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

title: Tale Sweeper Demo
description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

title: Leave On Time Demo
description: Leave on Time is a co-op roguelite dungeon crawler about overtime, office absurdity, and fighting for your right to clock out. Technically up to 32 players depend on network.

title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy Demo
Royal Goldenbeak and the Curse of Snowy Island Demo
description: 2D Comic, Arcade, Adventure fighter. Hand Drawn, Awesome Soundtrack. Upgradeable abilities. Fun Boss Battles. Comic Book Dialogue style with NPCs. Linear, fighting game with obstacles, traps and puzzles. Forgiving checkpoints. Unforgiving enemies.

title: 疫区求生 Demo
description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

title: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements Demo
description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

title: Shuffle Bistro Demo
description: A restaurant-themed deck-building roguelike that surpasses sales targets through the synergy of menu, facilities, and perks

title: Drone Soccer Demo
description: Pilot a caged racing drone as you dodge defenses to score goals or knock opponents out of the sky! We wanted to get the core flight simulation into your hands as soon as possible so you can start practicing. Master your skills in single-player modes today and prepare for the full release.

title: Haunted Echoes Demo
description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

title: Zyntaris Demo
description: Try the free demo version of Zyntaris: fight thousands of enemies, collect weapons and magical tomes, switch camera views, and defeat the final boss on the first map.

title: Steps To The Stars Demo
description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

title: City of Hunger Demo
description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

title: A Case of Missing Identity [DEMO]
description: [1.5 ACT DEMO] A point-and-click horror/tragedy visual novel about melding your perception of the world around you. Walk around, drive people to their death, and shape Perdita's existence. Remember: The flesh-sin is nothing. Before she can become everything, you must make her into something.

title: I Like Trains Demo
description: You like trains? Good, you are going to need a lot of them. Grow from a single train line into a sprawling transporation network in this incremental train game. Move passengers, invest in more trains, new lines, unlock new buildings and of course, buy lots of upgrades.

title: Storm Grill Demo
description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

title: VIRUS_31.EXE Demo
description: A virus has breached the system. You have 3 minutes to contain it. Build a weapon system from cards, survive escalating chaos, and earn bits that compound into exponential power. A survivors-like with an incremental twist.

title: Harvestide Demo
description: Deckbuilding + farming Roguelike — Free Demo! Draw, plant, cast, and survive the Barren Moon. Chapter 1 included. Master dual resources and turn the tide with events. The Barren Moon awaits. Ready?

title: The Blade Demo
description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

title: Void Havoc Demo
description: In this sci-fi action/strategy game, you're the only trump card left to stop the Contingency in their destructive march. Man your ship, build your arsenal and blow away the waves sent to stop you in your tracks.

title: Bloodwright Demo
description: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG rogue-lite.

title: Egg Farm
description: Become the Ultimate Egg Farm Owner!Build your dream farm through relaxing idle progression while collecting resources and crafting your own overpowered egg build with a wide variety of random upgrades and powerful abilities.

title: Manggou demo
description: Dash at breakneck speed, slash mid-air, chain bizarre gadgets, dash and cut through a juice-bursting frenzy, become the fastest blade in the orchard.

title: Card: Heroes and Dispute Demo
description: In this unique strategy RPG, you must collect resources and recruit an army by stacking cards in a fantasy world. Explore mysterious rooms, ingeniously use limited space to assemble powerful combat units, and face turn-based boss battles.

title: Affiliated Homies Demo
description: Banana!Blast your homies in this casual ahh multiplayer game with absurd recoil. Even has voice chat >:p. Two Teams, One MissionJoin the Affiliated and protect your gold. OR play as an undercover cop on a mission to recover it all.

title: Tough Cat Demo
description: This is a survival shooter game where players must survive in a stationary shooting format. You can play effortlessly with only the mouse plus Q and W keys. You may enter the shop periodically to buy items to grow stronger and boost your survival odds, which serves as the core gameplay.

title: Pixel Three Kingdoms: Zombie Dungeon Demo
Cube Foundry Demo
description: Cube Foundry is a cosmic idle & incremental clicker. Click to forge cubes, automate with generators, and stack upgrades. Prestige to grow stronger, unleash Overclock surges, draw high-risk roguelite cards, brew potions, and tend the Cube Garden minigame.

title: BudMageddon Demo
description: Grow a cosmic cannabis empire in this chill pixel-art idle-clicker. Plant, grow, harvest, and automate the farm — then prestige across 10 alien sectors from Earth to Andromeda. Pure number-go-up bliss, with a green thumb. 🌱👽🚀

title: Bastion Heart Demo
description: A tactical tower defense where you can freeze time to reposition units mid-battle, gear them up with items, enhance them with skill trees, and unleash powerful abilities to clear massive waves of enemies and challenging bosses!

title: Democracy Manifest Alpha Demo
description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! It’s your job to craft the legislation cards on your desk into crowd-pleasing bills. Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

title: Project Quickgunner: Initial Run
description: Project Quickgunner is a linear, first-person shooter, multi-level game where you go on various missions from cityscapes, hidden laboratories, and more - finding important items and eliminating those who stand in your way.

title: Murder Meet Cute Demo
description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

title: LYNK: The Algorithm of Intimacy Demo
description: LYNK: The Algorithm of Intimacy is a dark psychological thriller that begins inside a dating app. It sees not just what you type, but your hesitation, silence, and hidden desires. As you chat with Nora, Mira, and Iris, the app starts learning who you really are. Every choice leaves a trace.

title: Stardust Protocol Demo
description: Between bullet hell, black markets, and star-map strategy, chart a branching route of your own. Combine Scatter, Missile, Homing, and Laser weapons with 100+ items and 30+ random events—each sortie reshapes your build. Balance risk and reward in unknown systems and blaze your trail through the void.

title: Descent of Yomi Demo
description: The free demo of Descent of Yomi, a Japanese-folklore roguelike deckbuilder. Play through Chapter 1 — forge your deck, cut down yokai, and master the killing blow and the "rewind of the afterlife." Enjoyed it? Wishlist the full game.

title: Deepforge Brawl Demo
description: Deepforge Brawl is a dwarven arena roguelite where your weapons fire themselves — you just have to survive. Charge your beard, chug your ale, dash through goblin hordes. The free demo is your first five waves: all six dwarves, the full Forge, your first boss. Your records carry into the full game.

title: Wisp: Elemental Conflict Demo
description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

title: Sword of Ace Demo
description: A punishing 3rd-person soulslike action RPG set in a blood-soaked Gothic Horror Victorian world. Step into the armor of a final knight from the Sword of Ace Order, wield your iron sword against terrifying demonic hordes, and fight to survive the grim, mysterious remnants of a fallen civilization.

title: Fatemender Demo Version
description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy Demo
description: 1990. End of an era. Glam metal is on the ropes and one band is thrashing the local music scene. Fight for freedom from the mediocrity of your high school life, turning foes into fans while making lyrical choices during battle to create your own rock anthems. Turn-based tactics turned up to eleven!

title: content moderator. Demo
description: To pay for your mother's surgery, you take on a shady part-time job: "content moderator" Your task is to delete the "forbidden images" that must never see the light of day. Survive the creeping curses of this abnormal office.

title: 在落叶堆之外 Demo
description: In Toronto's cold, dry, pitch-black polar night, a four-string bass roars in a freezing basement. Sink into punker Jack's drug‑induced, hallucinatory "trip"—face the overwhelming unease through twisted fluid colors and a torn, fractured vision.

title: Tube2K Demo
description: Build the video sharing platform that will change the world. Will you bring about the Golden Age of humanity or bring it to its knees?

title: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul Demo
description: HollowCity is a top-down extraction shooter where you venture out from your safehouse to explore and scavenge for loot. Seize spoils from hostile enemies, rescue allies to upgrade your base, and find your way out of the devastated city.

title: Dittung Dittung Demo
description: Dittung Dittung is a 2D stealth action game where Pippi, an adorable penguin, sneaks into a seal's hideout to reclaim the fish they stole from her colony. Use Pippi's unique penguin movements, hide using the environment, and outsmart dangerous predators to take back what's yours!

title: Find Cats 8 Magical Plant Kingdom Demo
CRUSHCHOP DEMO
description: From a hidden bastard son to the Lord of Sunlit City! Rebuild a burned realm through gambling in an arena of clashing warriors. You will gamble, rally soldiers, build castles, mine resources, raid giants, and do it all in CRUSHCHOP!

title: Heartbeat Impact Demo
description: Transform into a love-bearing pinball, smashing through every obstacle to break down the walls around her heart. Only by maintaining extreme high speed can you pierce through the barriers unscathed.

title: 末世信使 Demo
description: 《末世信使》是一款 Roguelike 策略背包管理游戏。每一次冒险都充满未知，你将收集随机的道具,遭遇随机的事件，自由构筑专属卡组、升级能力、打造定制武器。突破重重挑战，携手伙伴，一同拯救未来的末世世界！

title: Adamant of Honor Demo
description: Fight through a secret research facility overrun by robots, mutants, and hostile forces. Scavenge weapons, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the power of the mysterious Adamant Stone before humanity falls into chaos.

title: Seasonal Lockdown Demo
description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

title: The voodoo soldier Demo
description: In The Voodoo Soldier, your weapons consume your life. Miss your shots, waste your life. Kill enemies to make them drop what keeps you alive. Aggression fuels survival, and high health unlocks your deadliest weapons. Shoot. Heal. Survive.

title: HAM HOLE Demo
description: You've just awoken to your first day of a mandatory life sentence. You are one of many, tasked with solving an imminent national catastrophe. Between the horrid mystery meat they send down the tubes, to the disgusting infestation that makes it's home here, there is no glory to be found in this work.

title: Study Abroad Sim Demo
description: A life simulation game inspired by the real experiences of international students. Study, survive, pay rent, manage your mental health, and build your life in foreign cities across the world.

title: Carpet Cleaning Master Demo
description: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Follow each carpet’s rules, keep an eye on your water and electricity bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim. Demo version!

title: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy! Demo
description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

title: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0 Demo
description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

title: According to the Emperor, Nothing Happened Demo
description: No empire lasts forever. Play devastating historical event cards, manipulate five core national attributes, and bring the greatest dynasties in Chinese history to collapse.

title: Laments of a Valiant Rose Demo
Butterfly: Twisted threads Demo
description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

title: Temperhall 1402 Demo
description: This is a simulation game where you manage a medieval blacksmiths' guild, and your goal is to grow the guild from a small workshop into an influential association of craftsmen. The demo version includes the early stages of the guild's development.

title: Paws & Circuits: Reboot Earth
description: A cozy explovival game where you play a wounded raccoon and his helper drone, cleaning a polluted 4×4 km island, recycling trash, gathering plants and surviving weather, seasons and hunger while slowly rebooting nature.
